usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover which IPSet and Alias names are valid in the source/destination fields of firewall rules for a specific LXC container. This is useful before creating or editing firewall rules to avoid referencing undefined objects. The caller requires VM.Audit permission on the target VMID.

examples.summary: List all firewall reference objects (aliases and ipsets) for LXC 110 on node pve01

tips: Omit the 'type' query parameter to return both aliases and ipsets in one call.
The 'scope' field in each result indicates whether the reference is defined at the container level or the cluster/datacenter level.
Use the returned 'ref' value (not 'name') when constructing firewall rule source/destination strings.
